description:
Claim or change the WhatsApp business username of a channel.

This changes what WhatsApp users see for the business, because the username can be shown instead of the phone number.
Meta may reject the username, in which case an error is returned.

force_transfer.description: Set to true only if the username is currently on another number of the same business portfolio and should move to this one. Defaults to false.

username.description: The username to claim for this number. Use 'get_business_username_suggestions' to see usernames reserved for it.

name: set_business_username
title: Set business username
